core_idea: Drifting Blade of Hongyuan Ryōshū is a Damage Dealer / Status Specialist — **Poise** fighter — stack on self, then spend on crits and scaling. **SP regenerator** — restores ally **SP** through passives and key skills.
playstyle_guide:
- Build **Poise Count** and **Potency** for crits and Coin Power scaling before committing **Aiding Strike ['''加斥我援''']** — **S2 — Engraved in Flesh and Bone ['''銘肌鏤骨''']** adds **+2 Poise Count** at **On Use**; **S1 — Hey, Back Off** adds **+1 Poise Count** at **On Use**.
- **Aiding Strike ['''加斥我援''']** is your highest-damage skill — use the setup skills above first, then commit it once stacks are up.
- **SP sustain** fires at **each turn** — restores **lowest-SP allies**.
- **Guard: Sentinel** grants 2 **Protector's Stance** automatically at Combat Start — you already have it on turn one; no defense turn required.

**S1 — Hey, Back Off** (BP 6, CP +7, 1 coin): rolls — low 6, high 13 (Extremely High).
- Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Poise on self + Rupture on target) (max 2); [On Use] Gain +1 Poise Count; [On Unopposed Attack] Inflict +1 Rupture Count

**S2 — Engraved in Flesh and Bone ['''銘肌鏤骨''']** (BP 4, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Average).
- Coin Power +1 for every 6 (Poise on self + Rupture on target) (max 2); [On Use] Gain +2 Poise Count
- Gain Poise equal to ((Rupture on target / 5) + 1) (max 6; rounded down)

**S3 — Aiding Strike ['''加斥我援''']** (BP 4, CP +3, 4 coins): rolls — low 4, high 16 (Slightly Low).
- Deal +2% damage on Critical Hit for every (Poise on self + Rupture on target) (max 100%); [On Hit] Inflict 2 Rupture

  - If "Hey, Back Off" is activated via the Passive 'I.L.T.L.T.', the Skill deals +30% damage on Critical Hit and heals 2~4 SP for 1 other al….

  - [Combat Start] Gain 2 Protector's Stance.
  - [On Use] This Skill gains +1 Defense Level for every 10% HP this unit cumulatively lost in this Encounter (max 6.
